dataset_identity: nq_open validation; Phase 9F validation[700:750], Phase 9G validation[750:800], and Phase 10C validation[3150:3200] used frozen QORE plus Answer Scorer selected K=5 contexts.

defects: Phase 9G only aggregated passages containing a gold answer literal and did not enumerate subsets of the complete frozen selected K=5 set.
The Phase 9F/9G cohorts are diagnostic, gold-conditioned post-inference subsets and do not establish a label-free selector effect.
validity.baseline_parity: Phase 9F/9G used one frozen Wiki-DPR Top-50 retrieval and QORE plus Answer Scorer K=5 selection before any oracle probe; Phase 10C independently confirmed selected-context parity across its arms.
validity.statistical_treatment: Phase 9F and Phase 9G summaries used fixed 2,000-repetition bootstrap procedures; Phase 10C reported exact paired all-question ties for baseline, reader, and matched control.

observations.claim: Among 26 selected-hit baseline EM errors with successful gold-copy control, 16 were beyond the tested local sentence/window contexts.
observations.baseline: frozen QORE plus Answer Scorer selected K=5 context

observations.claim: Among 18 selected-hit baseline EM errors with successful gold-copy control, 15 were beyond the tested answer-bearing selected and Top-50 contexts; the answer-bearing multi-passage class was zero.
observations.baseline: frozen QORE plus Answer Scorer selected K=5 context

observations.claim: Reader span energy changed decoding but tied both frozen greedy decoding and a matched non-reader control on all 50 questions.
observations.metric: all-question EM and F1 paired delta
observations.baseline: frozen greedy Generator.generate with selected K=5 context

artifacts.role: Phase 10C committed screen result and implementation

resource_budget: A 50-question diagnostic executes frozen retrieval, Answer Scorer, QORE selection, and baseline generation once per question; only eligible questions execute one gold-copy control and 30 additional non-full selected-set subset generations.
limitations: The evidence establishes a residual diagnostic uncertainty, not a utility gain or a selector mechanism.
All gold matching and answer evaluation remain oracle-only post-inference operations.
A positive topology diagnostic can authorize only a separately reviewed method portfolio, never an online mutation.
